notes.title: TaniNani Content Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I hope you all enjoy this update with a bunch of new things!

[h3]News:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 36 new levels
[*] 6 new unlockable outfits
[*] Chapter 1 & 2 are re-designed 
[*] Updated Challenge UI
[/list]

Hope that you have fun with the new content!

Take care,
Kevin

notes.title: TaniNani Patch #4
notes.notes:
A minor fix for the mouse input and Russian UI boxes should now be updated for certain levels that looked wrong.
[list]
[*]Moving chunks/tiles with mouse input while game is paused is fixed.
[*]Right click on the mouse pauses the game, which allows you to play through the entire game with just one hand.
[*]Russian UI box is fixed.
[*]Summary text when playing with Russian or Chinese language have updated positions to look more correct.
[/list]
Take care!
Kevin

notes.title: TaniNani Patch #3
notes.notes:
Mouse support is finally here! With that said... there are a few settings that can't be adjusted with the mouse only, but you should be able to fully play through the game and navigate the menu with the mouse only.

[list]
[*]Mouse support.
[*]Fixed a small issue where the grid would appear enabled a few milliseconds before the level slides down.
[*]Chapter 2 song volume is reduced a tiny bit.
[*]Fixed a text in the outfit section that wouldn't update it's button prompt if a controller was connected.
[/list]

Until next time, take care!

/Kevin

notes.title: TaniNani Patch #2
notes.notes:
Another small fix based on initial feedback from players. This should make the progression for new players a bit easier.
[list]
[*]First two outfits are unlocked a bit more quick.
[*]Chapter 2 is now unlocked at 6 crystals instead of 7.
[*]Restart level text in the "summary" screen should now look better in French.
[*]Russian translation should now be improved.
[*]Fixed a rare bug in the Chapter 4 mechanic.
[/list]
As always, thank you for the support of my little puzzle game!

/Kevin

notes.title: TaniNani Patch #1
notes.notes:
Thank you all for playing TaniNani, I've heard some feedback and I wanted to make a small and quick update.
[list]
[*]Challenges can now be replayed. If you've finished the challenges on a level and replay the level then the challenge background should be a bit transparent same as the crystal if you've grabbed that and replay the level.
[*]Added Russian translation.
[*]Updated credits.
[*]Removed a debug button that changed the selected language to Chinese.
[*]Adjusted pitch on Menu > Chapter > Level. Should be a bit more cute.
[*]Chapter 1 song, adjusted volume of the beat.
[/list]

Another request I've got is that people want proper mouse support for the menus which is currently on my list. Let me know if you've got more feedback!

/Kevin
